human.problem: In Genesis 21:18 the angel of God speaks as 'I' ('for I will make him into a great nation'). The card paraphrases this as 'God will make him into a great nation', which decides who the 'I' is. The text leaves that open.
human.question: When the angel of God speaks in the first person for God and the card paraphrases without quotation marks, may Papa Dorin attribute the 'I' to God? Or must he keep it as the angel's words, e.g. 'the angel says he will make him into a great nation'?

human.question: When a story card tells only a fact from outside the passage, should its verses field cite the outside reference (Genesis 17:12), or the passage verse it sets up (Genesis 21:4)?
